doc: Public-demo compatibility contract (owner clarification 2026-11-08). Authorization changes are action/resource-scoped: no blanket authentication at domain, subdomain, router, middleware or /m/* level on intentionally-public demo hosts. A documented public journey returning anything but its pinned response is a RELEASE BLOCKER. 'local' = the repo app runnable with TestClient (CI functionality+containment); 'live' = the hosted surface (nightly availability+response contract, scripts/probe_public_demo.py). classification pending-owner entries pin TODAY's behaviour so nothing changes silently. Baseline captured 2026-11-08 (audit 2026-11-08 §10).

public_journeys.live_note: 404 live (older build deployed); pinned locally, live probe status-widened until the demo host is redeployed

public_journeys.note: by design: the page needs the emailed ?code=; the guidance page is the public behaviour

protected_anonymous.live_note: 403 at the Cloudflare edge today; app-level 503 when PERMISSIONS_ADMIN_KEY is unset — both are denials; the contract accepts either layer but never 2xx

pinned pending_owner 2026-11-08 (audit §10 flag 1); B3 resolved — ADMIN_CONSOLE_API_KEY is now required (fail closed, 503 unset / 401 wrong-or-missing). The admin console runs the real engine against whichever cores a deployment configures — it cannot be presumed synthetic from the route alone, so it is protected like any other admin surface, not left public on the assumption that today's SIMULATE default mode would always hold.
